text.text_excerpt: Hot diggity dog now, this weiner spot is what's up! I passed by here taking a shortcut to get on Earhart Blvd and saw this gem stashed on the right side of me. Of course being the curious soul that I am, I had to go in and find out the origin of the name. Come to find out, they are a chain of several and are franchised. Now, to the weiner, I cannot tell a lie, this was probably the best hot dog I've had since visiting Coney Island. Wacked Out Weiner uses only Nathan hot dogs and I need not say anymore. You already know your mouth is drooling lol! Nathan's dogs, oooh Nathan's dogs are just the best. Now, when you add your choice of the many topping options, you will definitely be in for a ...

I've had Wacked Out Weiner (WOW) a few times now and let me tell ya. These hot dogs are not your ordinary dogs nor should one ever have to live by just the life of mustard, ketchup, and relish. HELL NO. Come to WOW and you'll be thrown some topping possibilities the 5 year old child within you would go nuts for. Now these dogs are for everyone! Gluten Allergens? They have gluten-free options including the buns and toppings. Vegan? Y'all... Their vegan chili cheese is so good that you will literally fool your carnivore friends. Vegetarian? They got ya! Need fruity pebbles and peanut butter for your hot dog? There's like 30 toppings here to make you happy. If you decide to dine-in there are...

Cool casual place. Hot dogs served fast , hot and delicious. Really I just wanted to check it out because of the name. Great logo ! Tried Reuben dog, backyard and rajun. Each loaded with toppings , wouldn't recommend wearing white . Looking forward to trying each dog.
